notes.title: Cross-platform gameplay just got smoother! Introducing fluid effect options
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, we are the "18LIGHT Game" team, and we're honored to communicate with you once again.

Since the debut of "Pronty", we have been committed to game system optimization and feature updates. Besides supporting SteamDeck upon our initial release, we have recently further optimized its compatibility to ensure players have a smoother and more efficient experience on SteamDeck. Now, you can enjoy enhanced operational responsiveness, fluid game visuals, and adjust the fluid effect quality for a prolonged gaming experience.

For PC users, we've also rolled out updates to the fluid effect quality option. Now, under the game's main menu in "Settings" - "Display" - "Fluid Effects", you can choose:

"Quality Priority": For those seeking top-notch visual effects.
"Performance Priority": Ensures the best gameplay fluidity, ideal for those wishing for faster game performance.

We've also addressed some known issues and bugs, significantly improving game stability. We value feedback from every player and will continue our efforts to ensure every update brings a better gaming experience. We warmly invite everyone to support "Pronty" and always welcome your valuable suggestions!

To express our gratitude for your love and support, "Pronty" is offering a 40% off limited-time discount until 2023/9/30. We look forward to more players joining our game world.

Lastly, we genuinely hope "Pronty"  provides an unforgettable gaming experience for everyone. If you enjoy it, "Pronty"  looks forward to your positive reviews and recommendations. Please join our official forum to share your gaming insights. Discord server link: https://discord.gg/HEap4TCC7e

v3.1.1 Update Highlights:

-Optimization for SteamDeck.
-Added fluid effect quality option for PC.
-Further optimization for PC compatibility.
-Fixed multiple known issues and bugs.
-Enhanced overall game stability.

notes.title: Pronty is an underwater Metroidvania with a terrific combat hook
notes.notes:
Pronty: Fishy Adventure launched on Steam this week. It's Metroidvania set underwater, which thanks to Aquaria will be a pretty familiar concept to connoisseurs of indie games. But Pronty's standout feature is its weapon, a sort of cyborg swordfish that has a mind of its own, and it gives the game's combat a very fun hook.

You play as Pronty, a little anthropomorphic fishy assigned as a defender of a fallen undersea city. The creatures around that city have mutated due to pollution, and - this being a Metroidvania - you'll have to explore the surrounding waters, fighting monsters and solving puzzles to unlock new abilities that will open access to new areas.

Your javelin attacks wherever you click, and you can mash your mouse button to lay out attacks on the enemies. But Pronty moves slowly while directing the javelin, and you still have to dodge attacks - so basically, you're controlling two characters at once. Eventually you'll get abilities like a dash that marks enemies for extra damage from the javelin's attacks, forcing you to control yourself and your weapon in ever-tighter concert.

Read the rest of the story...

notes.title: “Pronty; Fishy Adventure” has been released!
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=TZcaucA5lSo;full][/previewyoutube]

Hello everyone, we are 18Light Game.

I am very pleased to announce here that“Pronty; Fishy Adventure” is now officially on sale in the Steam store. The current version supports languages ​​including Traditional Chinese, Simplified Chinese, English, Japanese, and Korean, Russian, Brazilian Portuguese.

“Pronty; Fishy Adventure” is an adventurous action game based on the deep-sea world four hundred years from now. You will play as the guardian of the fledgling recruits-the half Murloc "Porty", and work for hand in hand with the javelin-type biochemical swordfish "Bronte" to repel all kinds of fish monsters mutated from marine debris, from the weird and thrilling In the hands of the enemy, rescue the undersea city in danger and implement the mission of protecting mankind. As the journey progresses, you will find many secrets buried in the deepest part of the deep-sea city "Roira" and unlock the truth about the monster invasion.

In this game, every step of the way is challenging and full of surprises. By collecting "memory version" props and learning skills to freely compose strategies, you can create diversified combat methods to break through numerous levels and create your own way of guardianship.

In addition, you may also wish to stop at the right time during the adventure, enjoy the underwater scenes, collect hidden props, read the game encyclopedia, and feel the unique atmosphere of the underwater world. There are also many easter eggs waiting for you to discover.

If you want to share your experience with us, please feel free to join the official community discussion area of ​​18Light Game. We look forward to sharing every brilliant and exciting journey with players.
